notes.title: Demo v0.5.0.7 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback and support for The Hundred Spirit Fox, this Demov 0.5.0.7 update is mainly focused on optimization, the updates are as follows:

[b][Added][/b
Added.1. Special thanks to add the player “熠_灰”
Added.2. “Reset destiny” function
Added.3. “Reset” Five Immortal Pillars function.
Added.4.New “Basic Resource Introduction” button in the pause menu.
Added .5. Game Settings interface adds “Gamma Brightness” adjustment.

[b][Optimization][/b
Optimize.1. Time is now fixed at night.
Optimization.2. Adjusted a wave of light effects (will be adjusted later).
Optimization.3. English translations of newly added phrases have been added.
Optimization.4. Modified loading interface
Optimization.5. Newly acquired treasure UI optimization.
Optimization.6. Injured red light enhancement
Optimization.7. Decreased damage of low difficulty monsters.
Optimization.8. Increase special magic treasure icon
Optimization.9. Blue ghost collision optimization for Big Stomach Bean
Optimization.10. Initial spiritual power giving fate has been enhanced from 3 points to 30 points each time.
Optimization.11. Initial increase in secondary damage enhancements
Optimization.12. Straw Monster and Wilderness Cat's bullets disappear after emptying the room.
Optimization.13. Added “(Broken Eggs don't need a key)” to the resource description of keys.
Optimization.14. Added “( does not change the attributes of the spirit animal carried outside the game)” text hint when choosing a spirit animal in the game.
Optimization.15. New exclamation mark on the heads of shopkeepers and hostage rescuers.
Optimize.16. Separate the special treasure icon from the attribute treasure icon.
Optimize.17.Optimize the priority of picking up blood vials every time when they overlap with other things to priority by location.
Optimize.18.Change the refresh position of the gourd drawn by the lucky draw machine.

[b]Bugs[/b]
Bug fix.1.The number of resurrection times does not increase after obtaining the magic treasure “Black Crystal Card”.
Bug fix.2. Fix a room stuck in the air wall BUG.
Bug fix.3. Eat burger avatar qualification did not change BUG

notes.title: Demo v0.5.0.6 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello ah, “Hundred change spirit fox” test has been carried out for two days, in the community has received a very large number of feedback, each player's feedback we attach great importance to, and made the Demo version of the 3rd version of the update, this update is as follows:

[b][New][/b]
Added.1. New basic resource description, mouse pointing up can be displayed
Added .2. Wasteland battle music.
Added.3. Added “blog” to the special thanks list.
Added .4. Added adaptation for foreign language players, if not Chinese language environment, then the unified open the game is English
Added .5. Increase the speed of blue return in low difficulty game.

[b][Optimization][/b
Optimization.1. BOSS clockwork rat red circle skills weakened
Optimize.2.
Optimization.3. All maps straightened out and charged all the way up! Branching rooms fixed on left and right
Optimize.4. No max power limit for raffle machine.
Optimize.5. Defense vice strengthened, no longer blocking your own bullets.
Optimize.6. When the skin is not unlocked, it will be displayed as “Obtained by saving the blacksmith and fixing the Five Immortal Pillars”.
Optimization.7. Changed the time to enter the village to night time.

[b][Bugs][/b
Bug fix.1.Hostage cage interaction failure BUG
Bug fix.2.Raffle machine can't be stopped BUG

Thank you to every player who supports and loves “Hundred Changes Spirit Fox”, your feedback is the way for the game to grow.

notes.title: Demo v0.5.0.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi Thank you for your positive feedback, we have noticed the problems that you feedback in the community and made the v0.5.0.5 update to optimize the player experience, the content of this update is as follows:


Optimization.1.The first level of the first world, the first level of the bag monster follow by difficulty weakening
Bug fixes.1. Fixed multiple interaction failures in villagers, lottery machines, etc.

Thank you for your positive feedback!

notes.title: Demo 0.5.0.4版本更新公告
notes.content:
[b]Thank you very much for your support and love for [Hundred Changes Spirit Fox], since yesterday's public Demo version until now, we have received very much feedback from players. [/b]

We are also the main listening to persuade, listen to the players' feedback and suggestions, made the first version of the Demo update, this update is as follows:

[b][Added][/b]
Added.1. Added 2K and 4K resolution
Added.2. Added UI tips for not enough mana
Added.3. Canceled auto-fire when obtaining new artifacts.
Added.4. Hide money and other information during battle, hide mini-map during battle.
Added.5. New pause confirmation link when guiding newbies.
Added .6. “Discard weapon” function in backpack.

[b][Optimization][/b
Optimize.1. Optimize item pickup.
Optimize.2. Cancel the display of weapon serial numbers in the backpack.
Optimization.3. Adjustment of mini-map view angle.
Optimize.4. Backpack UI optimization.
Optimize.5. Player status UI optimization.
Optimization.6. When acquiring treasure that deducts the upper limit of blood quantity, the current blood quantity is not deducted.

[b][BUG][/b
Bug fix.1.Repair ancient archive reading failure BUG
Bug fix.2.Repair foraging spirit gourd full of 99 can still buy BUG

Finally, thank you very much for trying to play [Hundred Change Spirit Fox], the game has any feedback and suggestions, welcome to add the official Discord exchange: https://discord.com/invite/FveT9fHy8d

notes.title: The Hundred Foxes Demo opens today! Explore the adventure with the little fox!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
Hello! The long-awaited day of adventure with the little foxes is finally here! 
The demo of the roguelike bullet-hell shooter " Protean Fox" is officially available!
The demo will feature brand-new worlds like the Ancient Fox Realm, Future Wasteland, and more, along with tons of equipment, a spirit beast capture system, and even a breeding system for you to explore!
Demo Details
[h2]Content:[/h2]
- First World: Ancient Fox Realm
- Second World: Future Wasteland
- Spirit Beast Equipment System
Available Period: April 15 – May 6
